_readme: Ratchet for .github/workflows/contracts-coverage.yml. The workflow reads one key, `lines`: the
minimum line coverage over contracts/src that the Sunday cron will accept. Below it, the run fails.
ARMED at 75 on the owner's word. The last measured run was 76.35% (workflow run 39292165414,
`measuredOn` below), which leaves a little over a point of room for fuzz and invariant jitter.
WHAT THE NUMBER COVERS: every file under contracts/src except TegridyTokenURIReader.sol, which
cannot be built under `forge coverage --ir-minimum`, and it leaves out the tests that assert
optimized bytecode size. NOTES.md, 2026-10-19, has the reasons.
IT ONLY MOVES UP. To raise it, run the workflow with `update_floor` checked and commit the printed
number here with `measured` and `measuredOn` set to that run. Lowering `lines` belongs in the same
PR that deliberately removes the coverage, with the reason in the commit message, and in
INVARIANT, enforced by that test: `lines` may never exceed `measured`, and while `measured` is
null `lines` must stay 0. A floor above the last real measurement is a permanently red cron,
